bagPolicy.summary: A clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bag up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches or a small clutch up to 4.5 × 6.5 inches is permitted. Larger purses, bags and backpacks are prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The venue owns no parking; garages and surface lots are within one or two blocks. It links to a ParkWhiz booking option but does not publish a universal rate.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue visitor guide does not designate an app-based rideshare pickup point.

concessions.summary: The venue sells beer, spirits, nonalcoholic drinks and snacks but does not serve meals; restaurants are nearby.

accessibility.summary: Call the box office ahead at 313-230-2436; on show day, call the ADA coordinator at 313-230-2434 on arrival or tell Guest Services at the front of the line.
